rounds.name: Resume Shortlisting
rounds.description: The resume shortlisting round was conducted through a Google Form in which candidates were required to fill in details about their previous experiences, including committee involvement, internships, and key learnings.

rounds.name: Online Interview
rounds.description: An online interview conducted by the founder, conversational in nature, aiming to understand background, motivation, and alignment with the company and role.

questions.text: Why were you opting for a non-technical role?
What did you learn from your previous internship experience?
Where is your place of stay and when will you be able to join if selected?

rounds.name: Offline Interview
rounds.description: An in-depth and practical offline interview focusing on handling pressure, managing multiple responsibilities, and performing in a sales-oriented role.

questions.text: How do you handle pressure and manage multiple responsibilities?
Pitch the company's product to the founder as if I were convincing a potential client.

tips.text: Prepare a strong explanation of why you are choosing the role/domain, especially if it is non-technical.
Research the company, product, and target market thoroughly.
Always prepare at least one suggestion or improvement idea related to the product.
Practice a basic sales or product pitch before the interview.
Be ready to discuss how you manage pressure and prioritize tasks.
Stay calm and confident during the interview.
Listen carefully to the questions before answering.
Be honest about challenges and explain how you handled them.
Ask at least one meaningful question at the end of the interview.
Maintain positive body language and clear communication.
